title: We offer a wide range of assessments for a variety of questions
description: There are many reasons to seek assessment. Below are some of the common categories of assessment we offer. Call us today if you don't see the type of testing you are looking for.

slides.title: Initial clinical interview
slides.description: A detailed conversation to map your history, current symptoms, and what you want out of the assessment. No shortcuts.

slides.title: Standardized testing
slides.description: Validated instruments selected for your specific referral question — mood, cognition, personality, or neuropsychological functioning.

slides.title: Behavioral observation
slides.description: In-session observation of how you approach tasks, handle frustration, and organize your thinking. These patterns rarely show up on a self-report.

slides.title: Collateral review
slides.description: We review previous records, school reports, or input from family when you authorize it — every data point that builds a complete picture.

slides.title: Integrated report & feedback
slides.description: A written report with clear diagnostic findings, recommendations, and a feedback session where we walk through results and answer every question.
